Name: Daily Special Orders
Author: shekurika
Description:
This mod allows to configure how often the Special Order Board refreshes, options are daily and immediately after picking one. You will always have the full duration after picking an order. Compatible with Generic Mod Config Menu for easier configuration. Also works on the board in a certain lategame location.

[b]Config
[/b]The config looks now something like this:
[code]﻿  "SORefreshes": [
    false, //refresh immediately
    true, //unused (signals Mondays but it'll always refresh on Monday)
    true, //refresh Tuesday
    true, //refresh Wednesday
    true, //refresh Thursday
    true, //refresh Friday
    true, //refresh Saturday
    true //refresh Sunday
  ],
[/code]
